load_bearing: positive diagonal/full-rank pinching
independent_check: INDEPENDENT DERIVATION DONE 2026-08-24, but NOT the one the audit asked for -- see finding. The genuinely independent route is MIXTURE OF UNITARIES: the pinching map is the uniform mixture P(rho) = (1/N) sum_m Z^m rho (Z^m)* over diagonal phase unitaries Z = diag(omega^j), omega = e^{2 pi i / N}. Concavity of von Neumann entropy then gives S(P(rho)) >= (1/N) sum_m S(Z^m rho (Z^m)*) = S(rho) by unitary invariance. This uses only concavity and unitary invariance -- no Klein, no relative entropy
finding: F-11; S1-2026-08-20 pending -> CLEARED 2026-08-24. ★ FINDING: THE AUDIT'S OWN SUGGESTED CHECK WAS CIRCULAR. It asked for an 'independent relative-entropy derivation', but Klein's inequality tr[rho log rho] >= tr[rho log sigma] IS the nonnegativity of quantum relative entropy D(rho||sigma) >= 0, and the corpus proof already runs on it. A relative-entropy derivation would restate the existing proof, not check it. Replaced with the mixture-of-unitaries route, which is genuinely independent
